name: Young Talent Programme for AI in Finance (YTP-AIF)
description: A pilot programme by the Institute of Banking and Finance (IBF), supported by the Monetary Authority of Singapore, that prepares Year 2 to Year 4 undergraduates for an AI-enabled financial sector. Participants work through a foundational AI masterclass, an applied learning stage building on real-world industry problem statements, and a project presentation to participating financial institutions.

name: Kiro University Challenge
description: A one-week crash course for Kiro. Follow daily lessons Monday through Thursday, then build and submit one project for the Final to earn Kiro credits. Open to everyone: students, first-time builders, and experienced developers alike.

name: Build Over Nights: Kiro x Quick Hackathon
description: "Build Through Chaos Over Night." A high-intensity 24-hour sprint designed to force rapid ideation, unconventional problem-solving, and the deployment of functional prototypes under pressure.

name: AWS Student Community Day Thane 2026
description: AWS Student Community Day Thane 2026 is a full-day student tech conference on 3rd October at Kriyan Banquet Hall, Thane. Built for students by students and backed by AWS, it features sessions on Cloud, DevOps, AI/ML, networking, and real industry exposure.

name: Hackday Islamabad 2026
description: Join us for a hands-on Hackday in Islamabad featuring mini-hackathon challenges, practical workshops, inspiring speaker sessions, and opportunities to contribute to open source.

name: CloudNativeGeo (CNG) Forum 2026
description: The second annual CNG Forum in Snowbird, Utah, where innovators and practitioners in the geospatial industry gather to share knowledge and advance the field. The event runs keynotes, technical sessions, workshops, and hands-on collaboration, including an AWS workshop that features Kiro.

name: Islamabad Hack 2026
description: Islamabad Hack 2026 brings builders together at Barani Institute of Technology to build practical solutions around climate change. Compete, collaborate, and turn ideas into working prototypes.

name: CUSEC 2027
description: Canada's largest undergraduate software engineering conference, featuring a Kiro track in the Dev's Den pitch competition.

name: CUTC Montreal
description: Canada's largest undergraduate tech conference comes to Montreal. Canadian Undergraduate Technology Conference 2026 (CUTC 2026: TRANSFORM) brings together 500+ ambitious students, founders, and builders for a high-energy day of talks, networking, and hands-on collaboration centered on AI, startups, and the future of technology. Featuring standout speakers including Harley Finkelstein (President, Shopify), Stefania Pecore (AI Ethics Expert, UNESCO), and Yacine Mahdid (Founder, Axya).
